comment_regular: Oblivion TESTopic::LoadForm recognizes XIDX (unlike TESCS TESTopic_LoadForm 0x4F02D0) and writes it to the separate TESTopic.unk30 U32 field using GetChunkData4. This is raw runtime scalar storage; this loader performs no FormID resolution for XIDX. The TESCS loader's QSTI/QSTR quest-list paths are separate.
